## Answer: $c^* = \tfrac{1}{3}$

**Lower bound.** Take $n/3$ disjoint directed triangles. Each triangle is an oriented graph with maximum total degree 2, so the whole graph has $\Delta \le 4$. Each triangle is a directed cycle, so every feedback vertex set must contain at least one vertex from each triangle. Hence $fvs(D) = n/3$, which forces $c^* \ge 1/3$.

**Upper bound.** I'm recalling, not re-deriving, a published result: every oriented graph with maximum total degree at most 4 has a feedback vertex set of size at most $n/3$. I did not verify this bound in this session. Given that the lower-bound construction matches $n/3$ exactly, $1/3$ is the value I'm taking as $c^*$.

ANSWER: 1/3
